name: Mikado Kurofune
source:
Hobbies: Watching videos of rocket takeoffs
Special Skills: Intimidating all those before him by virtue of existing
Likes: Japanese food
Dislikes: Frivolity, in all its forms

The one and only chairman, president, and founder of Amakawa Noble Academy. [url=/c17304]Taigi's[/url] father who is a widower. He utterly despises anything he deems hollow or extravagant, and styles himself as pragmatic to a fault in everything he says or does. The weight of his presence is far too heavy for any ordinary mortal to bear.

He's the person responsible for inviting [url=/c17297]Shinri[/url], the Sixth Crown, to the Academy. His true intentions? Only he knows...

[Edited from [url=https://hello.nekonyansoft.com/chara.html]official English page[/url]]
